s.d: σποδός, -oῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for אֵפֶר ;] ashes: [[hebrews 9 13|Heb.9:13;]] ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. ([[isaiah 58 5|Isa.58:5]], [[john 3 6|Jhn.3:6]], Dan LXX 9:3, al.), [[matthew 11 21|Mat.11:21]], [[luke 10 13|Luk.10:13]].† (AS)

σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ (σπείρω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 19 29|4Ki.19:29]] (זָרַע), 1Ma.10:30 * ;] 1. a sowing. 2. seedtime. 3. seed sown (of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): [[1-peter 1 23|1Pe.1:23]] (cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, NTD, 105 f.).† (AS)

σπόριμος, -ον (σπείρω) [in LXX: [[genesis 1 29|Gen.1:29]], [[leviticus 11 37|Lev.11:37]] (זָרַע), Sir 40:22 א1 * ;] fit for sowing, sown; as subst., τὰ σ., corn-fields: [[matthew 12 1|Mat.12:1]], [[mark 2 23|Mrk.2:23]], [[luke 6 1|Luk.6:1]].† (AS)

σπόρος, -ου, ὁ (σπείρω), [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;] = σπορά, 1. sowing or seedtime. 2. seed sown (so usually in late Gk.): [[mark 4 26|Mrk.4:26-27]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5, 11]], [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10]] a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10]] b.† (AS)

σπουδάζω (σπουδή), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל ;] to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205 f.), [[galatians 2 10|Gal.2:10]], [[ephesians 4 3|Eph.4:3]], [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17]], [[2-timothy 2 15|2Ti.2:15 4:9 4:21]], [[titus 3 12|Tit.3:12]], [[hebrews 4 11|Heb.4:11]], [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10 3:14]]; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii), [[2-peter 1 15|2Pe.1:15]] (for other constructions see LS, see word).† (AS)

σπουδαῖος, -α, -ον (σπουδή), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 41 25|Eze.41:25]] * ;] in haste; hence, zealous, eager, diligent, earnest: before ἐν, [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22;]] compar., -οτεροσς [[2-corinthians 8 17|2Co.8:17]] (here in superl. sense, see Bl., § 44, 3) [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22.]]† (AS)
- more earnestly diligently, seriously, earnestly than others), i.e. very promptly
- more diligent, prompt, earnest

earnestly, zealously, with vigor; (compar.) all the more eager, with special urgency eagerly earnestly, eagerly, diligently, [[luke 7 4|Lk. 7:4]]; [[2-timothy 1 17|2Tim. 1:17;]] [[titus 3 13|Tit. 3:13;]] comparative σπουδαιοτέρως, more earnestly, with special urgency, [[philippians 2 28|Phil. 2:28]]

σπουδαίως adv. (σπουδαῖος), [in LXX: Wis.2:6 * ;] 1. with haste or zeal, i.e. earnestly, zealously, diligently: [[luke 7 4|Luk.7:4]], [[2-timothy 1 17|2Ti.1:17]], [[titus 3 13|Tit.3:13]]; compar., -οτέρως, [[philippians 2 28|Php.2:28]] (RV, Lft., Weymouth, al., but see infr.) 2. hastily, speedily: compar., -οτέρως, [[philippians 2 28|Php.2:28]] (Thayer, Zorell, see word; ICC, in l, al., but see supr.).† (AS)

σπουδή, -ῆς, ἡ (σπεύδω), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל, its parts and derivatives ;] 1. haste, speed: μετὰ σ. (Wis.19:2), [[mark 6 25|Mrk.6:25]], [[luke 1 39|Luk.1:39]]. 2. zeal, diligence, earnestness: [[romans 12 11|Rom.12:11]], [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11-12 8:7-8]]; ἐν σ., [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8]] (see M, Pr, 104); before ὑπέρ, [[2-corinthians 8 16|2Co.8:16;]] σπουδὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι, [[hebrews 6 11|Heb.6:11;]] σ. παρεισφέρειν, [[2-peter 1 5|2Pe.1:5;]] πᾶσαν σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Ju 3 (see MM, xxiii; M, Pr., 214; Deiss., BS, 361, 364).† (AS)

σφυρίς (T, Rec. σπυρίς, see WH, App., 148; 131., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ, a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: [[matthew 15 37|Mat.15:37 16:10]], [[mark 8 8|Mrk.8:8, 20]] [[acts 9 25|Act.9:25]] (see: κόφινος).† (AS)

στάδιον, -ου, τό pl., στάδια ([[john 6 19|Jhn.6:19]], T), and metapl., στάδιοι (see B1., 9, 1), [in LXX: Dan LXX 4:9, Sus 1:37, 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:9 ff. * ;] a stadium, i.e. 1. a measure of length = 600 Greek feet or 1⁄8 of a Roman mile [[matthew 14 24|Mat.14:24]] (Rec., WH, txt., R, mg.), [[luke 24 13|Luk.24:13]], [[john 6 19|Jhn.6:19 11:18]], [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20 21:16]], and, this being the length of the Olympic course, 2. a race-course: [[1-corinthians 9 24|1Co.9:24.]]† (AS)

στάρνος, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ [in LXX: [[exodus 16 33|Exo.16:33]] (צִנְצֶנֶת), 3Ki.12:24 14:3 (בַּקְבֻּק), Dan LXX Bel, 1:32 * ;] prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, a jar: [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4.]]† (AS)

στάσις, -εως, ἡ (ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for עָמַד, its parts and derivatives, also for רִיב (Pr 1714), etc. (see Deiss., BS, 158 f.) ;] 1. a standing, place, status: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), [[hebrews 9 8|Heb.9:8.]] 2. insurrection, sedition: [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], [[luke 23 19|Luk.23:19, 25]], [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40 24:5]]. 3. In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) [[acts 15 2|Act.15:2 23:7, 10]].† (AS)
στατήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ [in Aq., Sm., for מִשְׁקָל ;] a stater; (a) a weight; (b) a coin (used by late writers of the Greek τετράδραχμον): [[matthew 17 27|Mat.17:27 26:16]], WH, mg.† (AS)

σταυρός, -oῦ, ὁ 1. an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.) 2. In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, the Cross: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, [[matthew 27 32|Mat.27:32, 40 27:42]], [[mark 15 21|Mrk.15:21, 30 15:32]], [[luke 23 26|Luk.23:26]], [[john 19 17|Jhn.19:17, 19 19:25, 31]], [[colossians 2 14|Col.2:14]], [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2]]; θάνατος σταυροῦ, [[philippians 2 8|Php.2:8;]] τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., [[colossians 1 20|Col.1:20.]] Metaphorical, in proverbial sayings: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., [[matthew 10 38|Mat.10:38 16:24]], [[mark 8 34|Mrk.8:34 10:21]], 15:21, [[luke 9 23|Luk.9:23 14:27]] (for an interesting ex. of metaphorically use in π., see MM, xxiii) By meton., for Christ's death on the Cross: [[1-corinthians 1 17|1Co.1:17]], [[galatians 5 11|Gal.5:11 6:12, 14]], [[ephesians 2 16|Eph.2:16]], [[philippians 3 18|Php.3:18]]; ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σ., [[1-corinthians 1 18|1Co.1:18.]]† (AS)

σταυρόω, -ῶ (σταυρός), [in LXX: [[esther 7 9|Est.7:9]] (תָּלָה), [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]] * ;] 1. to fence with pales, impalisade (Thuc.). 2. In late writers (Polyb., FlJ; but ἀνασταυρόω is more common) to crucify: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 20 19|Mat.20:19 23:34 26:2 27:22]] ff. [[matthew 28 5|Mat.28:5]], [[mark 15 16|Mrk.15:16]] ff. [[mark 16 6|Mrk.16:6]], [[luke 23 21|Luk.23:21, 23 23:33 24:7, 20]], [[john 19 6|Jhn.19:6]] ff., [[acts 2 36|Act.2:36 4:10]], [[1-corinthians 1 13|1Co.1:13 1:23 2:2 2:8]], [[2-corinthians 13 4|2Co.13:4]], [[galatians 3 1|Gal.3:1]], [[revelation 11 8|Rev.11:8]]; metaphorically, [[galatians 5 24|Gal.5:24 6:14]].† (AS)

σταφυλή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX for עֵנָב ;] a bunch of grapes: [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16]], [[luke 6 44|Luk.6:44]], [[revelation 14 18|Rev.14:18]]. "σ. is properly the ripe grape-cluster as opposite to ὄμφαξ, cf. [[genesis 40 10|Gen.40:10]], [[job 15 33|Job.15:33]]; as contrasted with βότρυς, it describes the grapes rather than the cluster on which they grow" (Swete, Apoc., 187 f.).† (AS)
στάχυς, -υος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for שִׁבֹּל ;] an ear of corn: [[matthew 12 1|Mat.12:1]], [[mark 2 23|Mrk.2:23 4:28]], [[luke 6 1|Luk.6:1]].† (AS)
Στάχυς, -υος, ὁ Stachys: [[romans 16 9|Rom.16:9]] (see Lft., Phi., 174; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

στέγη, -ης, ἡ (στέγω) [in LXX: [[genesis 8 13|Gen.8:13]] (מְכַסֶּה), etc. ;] a roof: [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4;]] of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., [[matthew 8 8|Mat.8:8]], [[luke 7 6|Luk.7:6]] (cf. MM, xxiii).† (AS)

στέγω (cf. Lat. tego), [in LXX: Sir.8:17 * ;] 1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.). 2. to cover, keep secret, conceal (Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): [[1-corinthians 13 7|1Co.13:7]], R, mg. 3. By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure (for exx., see, Lft., Notes, 40; M, Th., 36): [[1-corinthians 9 12|1Co.9:12 13:7]], [[1-thessalonians 3 1|1Th.3:1 3:5]].† (AS)
στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον, [in LXX for עָקָר ;] barren: of a woman, [[luke 1 7|Luk.1:7, 36 23:29]], [[galatians 4 27|Gal.4:27]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

στέλλω [in LXX (mid.): [[malachi 2 5|Mal.2:5]] (חָתַת ni.), [[proverbs 31 24|Pro.31:24]] (26), Wis.7:14 14:1, 2Ma.5:1, 3Ma.1:19 3Mac 4:11 * ;] 1. prop., to set, place, arrange, fit out; hence, mid., to set oneself for, prepare (Wis, xi Mac, ll. with). 2. to bring together, gather up (in Hom. of furling sails), hence to restrain, check; mid., to restrain or withdraw oneself, hold aloof, avoid: [[2-corinthians 8 20|2Co.8:20;]] before ἀπό, [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐξ-απο-, συν-απο-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στέλλω).† (AS)
στέμμα, -τος, τό (στέφω, to put around, enwreath) a wreath, garland: as used in sacrifices, [[acts 14 13|Act.14:13.]]† (AS)
στεναγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (στενάζω), [in LXX for אֲנָחָה, אֲנָקָה, נְאָקָה, etc. ;] a groaning: [[acts 7 34|Act.7:34]] (LXX κραυγή), [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26.]]† (AS)

στενάζω [in LXX for אָנַח ni., אָנַק, etc. ;] to groan ("the word denotes feeling which is internal and unexpressed," Mayor, Ja., 162): [[mark 7 34|Mrk.7:34]], [[2-corinthians 5 2|2Co.5:2 5:4]], [[hebrews 13 17|Heb.13:17]], [[james 5 9|Jas.5:9]] (EV, murmur); ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, [[romans 8 23|Rom.8:23]] (cf. ἀνα-, συ(ν)-στενάζω).† SYN.: see: κλαίω (AS)
στενός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for צַר, etc. ;] narrow: fig (v MM, xxiii), [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13-14]], [[luke 13 24|Luk.13:24]].† (AS)

στενο-χωρέω, -ῶ (στενός + χῶρος, space) [in LXX: [[joshua 17 15|Jos.17:15]] (אוּץ), [[judges 16 16|Jdg.16:16]] (אָלַץ pi.), [[isaiah 28 19|Isa.28:19]] (20) (קָצַר) [[isaiah 49 19|Isa.49:19]] (צָרַר), 4Ma.11:11 * ;] 1. to be straitened (cf. [[isaiah 49 19|Isa.49:19]]); metaphorically, to be anxious (Hipp., al.). 2. In late writers, trans., to straiten, compress (LXX, Diod., al.; π. ap. MM, xxiii): pass., trop., [[2-corinthians 4 8|2Co.4:8 6:12]].† (AS)

στενοχωρία, -ας, ἡ (see supr.) [in LXX for צוֹק, etc. ;] narrowness of space, want of room (Thuc., al.). Metaphorical (Ken., Polyb., [[deuteronomy 28 53|Deu.28:53]], Wis.5:3, al.), difficulty, distress: θλίψις καὶ (ἢ) σ., [[romans 2 9|Rom.2:9 8:35]] (EV, anguish); pl. (cf. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220), [[2-corinthians 6 4|2Co.6:4 12:10]].† SYN.: θλίψις, q.v (AS)

στερεός, -ά, -όν [in LXX: [[numbers 8 4|Num.8:4]] (מִקְשָׁה); σ. πέτρα, [[isaiah 5 28|Isa.5:28]] (צַר), etc. ;] hard, firm, solid: τροψή, [[hebrews 5 12|Heb.5:12, 14]]; θεμέλιος, figuratively, [[2-timothy 2 19|2Ti.2:19.]] Metaphorical, (a) in bad sense, hard, cruel (Hom., al.); (b) in good sense, steadfast, firm: τ. πίστει, [[1-peter 5 9|1Pe.5:9.]]† (AS)

στερεόω, -ῶ (στερεός), [in LXX: [[isaiah 42 5|Isa.42:5]] (רָקַע), [[jeremiah 5 3|Jer.5:3]] (חָזַק pi.), etc. ;] (a) to make firm or solid; (b) to strengthen, make strong; with accusative of person(s), [[acts 3 16|Act.3:16;]] τ. βάσεις, pass., [[acts 3 7|Act.3:7.]] Metaphorical (cf. Je, l.with): τ. πίστει, pass., [[acts 16 5|Act.16:5.]]† (AS)

στερέωμα, -τος, τό (στερεόω), [in LXX: [[genesis 1 6|Gen.1:6]] ff., [[psalms 19 1|Psa.19:1 150:1]], [[ezekiel 1 22|Eze.1:22-26 10:1 13:5]], Dan LXX, TH [[daniel 3 56|Dan.3:56]], [[daniel 12 3|Dan.12:3]] (רָקִיעַ), [[deuteronomy 33 26|Deu.33:26]] (שַׁחַק), [[psalms 18 2|Psa.18:2 71:3]] (סֶלַע), [[esther 9 29|Est.9:29]], I [[esther 8 78|Est.8:78]] (82), Sir.43:1, 8, 1Ma.9:14 * ;] a solid body; (a) a support, foundation (Arist., al.); metaphorically, strength ([[psalms 17 1|Psa.17:1-15 70:1-5]], 1Mac, ll. with); steadfastness, firmness: τ. πίστεως, [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5;]] (b) the dome of heaven (believed to be a solid canopy), the firmament (LXX).† (AS)
Στεφανᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ Stephanas: [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16 16:15 16:17]].† (AS)

στέφανος, -ου, ὁ (στέφω, to encircle), [in LXX chiefly for עֲטָרָה ;] 1. that which surrounds or encompasses (as a wall, a crowd: Hom., al.). 2. a crown, i.e. the wreath, garland or chaplet given as a prize for victory, as a festal ornament, or as a public honour for disting­uished service or personal worth (so to sovereigns, especially on the occasion of a παρουσία, which see; cf. Deiss., LAE, 372 ff.; on its use in LXX for the golden crown of royalty (prop., διάδημα, which see, cf. Hort and Mayor on [[james 1 12|Jas.1:12]]): [[matthew 27 29|Mat.27:29]], [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17]], [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2]], 5, [[1-corinthians 9 25|1Co.9:25]], [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4, 10 6:2 9:7 12:1 14:14]]. Metaphorical: [[philippians 4 1|Php.4:1]], [[revelation 3 11|Rev.3:11]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης (cf. Deiss., LAE, 312), [[2-timothy 4 8|2Ti.4:8;]] τ. δόξης, [[1-peter 5 4|1Pe.5:4;]] καυχήσεως, [[1-thessalonians 2 19|1Th.2:19]] (see M, Th., in l); τ. ζωῆς (genitive appos.), [[james 1 12|Jas.1:12]], [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10]].† (AS)
στεφανόω, -ῶ (στέφανος), [in LXX for עָטַר ;] with accusative of person(s), to crown: of a victor, [[2-timothy 2 5|2Ti.2:5.]] Metaphorical, δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, [[hebrews 2 7|Heb.2:7]], 9" (LXX) .† (AS)

στῆθος, -ους, τό [in LXX: [[exodus 28 23|Exo.28:23, 26]] (29-30) (לֵב), etc. ;] the breast: [[john 13 25|Jhn.13:25 21:10]], [[revelation 15 6|Rev.15:6]]; as a sign of penitence, τύπτειν (εἰς) τὸ σ., [[luke 18 13|Luk.18:13 23:48]],† (AS)

στήκω late Pres., formed from perf., ἕστηκα (see B1., § 17; WH, App., 169; Kennedy, Sources, 158; M, Pr., 238; MM, xxiii), [in LXX: [[exodus 14 13|Exo.14:13]] A, [[judges 16 26|Jdg.16:26]] B, [[1-kings 8 11|3Ki.8:11]] B * ;] = ἵστημι, to stand: [[mark 3 31|Mrk.3:31 11:25]], [[john 1 26|Jhn.1:26]], [[revelation 12 4|Rev.12:4]] (ἕστηκεν T). Metaphorical, to stand firm, stand fast: absol., [[galatians 5 1|Gal.5:1]] (but see Field, Notes, 189 f.), [[2-thessalonians 2 15|2Th.2:15;]] before ἐν, [[john 8 44|Jhn.8:44]] (ἕστηκεν, T, R, mg.), [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]], [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27 4:1]]; with dative, [[romans 14 4|Rom.14:4.]]† (AS)
στηριγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (στηρίζω), [in Sm.: [[isaiah 3 1|Isa.3:1]] * ;] 1. a setting firmly, supporting. 2. fixedness, firmness, steadfastness: [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17.]]† (AS)

στηρίζω [in LXX for סָמַךְ, שׂוּם, etc. ;] to fix, set fast, make fast: [[luke 16 26|Luk.16:26;]] τ. πρόσωτον ([[ezekiel 6 2|Eze.6:2 13:17]], al.; see Dalman, Words, 30 f.), [[luke 9 51|Luk.9:51.]] Metaphorical, to confirm, establish: with, accusative, [[luke 22 32|Luk.22:32]], [[acts 18 23|Act.18:23]], [[romans 1 11|Rom.1:11 16:25]], [[1-thessalonians 3 2|1Th.3:2 3:13]], [[2-thessalonians 3 3|2Th.3:3]], [[james 5 8|Jas.5:8]], [[1-peter 5 10|1Pe.5:10]], [[revelation 3 2|Rev.3:2]]; id. before ἐν, [[2-thessalonians 2 17|2Th.2:17]], [[2-peter 1 12|2Pe.1:12]].† (AS)

στίγμα -τος, τό (στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: [[song-of-solomon 1 11|Sng.1:11]] (נְקֻדָּה) * ;] a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, [[galatians 6 17|Gal.6:17]] (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).† (AS)
στιγμή, -ῆς, ἡ (στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: [[isaiah 29 5|Isa.29:5]] (פֶּתַע), 2Ma.9:11 * ;] a prick, a point; metaphorically, σ. χρόνου, a moment: [[luke 4 5|Luk.4:5.]]† (AS)
στίλβω [in LXX: [[nahum 3 3|Nam.3:3]] (לַהַב), etc. ;] to shine, glisten: [[mark 9 3|Mrk.9:3.]]† (AS)

στοά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX: [[ezekiel 40 18|Eze.40:18]] (רִצְפָּה), etc. ;] a portico: [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2;]] used of the covered colonnade in the Temple (EV, porch), [[john 10 23|Jhn.10:23]] [[acts 3 11|Act.3:11 5:12]] † (AS)
στοιβάς, see: στιβάς. στιβάς, -άδος, ἡ, [in Aq.: [[ezekiel 46 23|Eze.46:23]] (טִירוֺת) * ;] a litter of leaves or rushes: pl., [[mark 11 8|Mrk.11:8]] (Rec. στοιβ-).† (AS)

στοιχεῖον, -ου, τό [in LXX: Wis.7:17 19:18, 4Ma.12:13 * ;] prop., one of a row (στοῖχος) or series, hence, 1. the shadow-line of a dial (Aristoph.). 2. an elementary sound or letter of the alphabet (Anth., Plut., π.). 3. the elements or rudiments of knowledge (Arist., al.) [[hebrews 5 12|Heb.5:12;]] πτωχὰ σ., [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9;]] σ. τοῦ κόσμου, [[galatians 4 3|Gal.4:3]], [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8, 20]] (but see infr.). 4. The material elements of the universe (Plat.; LXX, ll. with): [[2-peter 3 10|2Pe.3:10 3:12]]. 5. The heavenly bodies (Ding. Laert.). 6. The demons or tutelary spirits of nature (Enoch., Test., Sol., al.; for this sense in Ga, Col, ll. with, see ICC on [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8;]] Enc. Bibl., see word " Elements ").† (AS)

στοιχέω, -ῶ (στοῖχος, a row), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 11 6|Ecc.11:6]] (כָּשֵׁר) * ;] to be in rows (of waves, plants, etc., as well as of men), to walk in line (esp. of marching in file to battle; Xen., Cyr., vi, 3, 34, al.). Metaphorical, in late writers, to walk by rule: [[acts 21 24|Act.21:24;]] with dative, to walk by or in (as a rule of life), [[romans 4 12|Rom.4:12]] (cf. MM, xxiii), [[galatians 5 25|Gal.5:25 6:16]], [[philippians 3 16|Php.3:16]] (cf. συν-στοιχέω).† (AS)

στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (στέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד, also for לְבוּשׁ, etc. ;] 1 1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.). 2. Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, a festal robe: (cf. [[jonah 3 6|Jon.3:6]], [[esther 8 15|Est.8:15]], 1Ma.6:15): [[mark 12 38|Mrk.12:38 16:5]], [[luke 15 22|Luk.15:22 20:46]], [[revelation 6 11|Rev.6:11 7:9, 13-14 22:14]].† (AS)

στόμα, -τος, τό [in LXX chiefly for פֻּם ;] the mouth: of man, [[matthew 15 11|Mat.15:11]], [[john 19 29|Jhn.19:29]], [[acts 11 8|Act.11:8]], al.; of animals, [[matthew 17 27|Mat.17:27]], [[2-timothy 4 17|2Ti.4:17]] (fig.), [[hebrews 11 33|Heb.11:33]], [[james 3 3|Jas.3:3]], al.; figuratively, of inanimate things (ποταμοῦ, Hom.), ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ σ., [[revelation 12 16|Rev.12:16;]] σ. μαχαίρας (Heb. חֶרֶב ־פֶּה, [[genesis 34 26|Gen.34:26]] al.), the edge of the sword, [[luke 21 24|Luk.21:24]], [[hebrews 11 34|Heb.11:34]]; esp. of the mouth as the organ of speech: opposite to καρδία, [[matthew 12 34|Mat.12:34]], [[romans 10 8|Rom.10:8, 10]]; in various phrases (some cl., some resembling Hebrew; cf. Bl., § 40, 9): ἀνοίγειν τ. σ. (see: ἀνοίγω); σ. πρὸς σ. (פֶּה ־אֵל פֶּה [[numbers 12 8|Num.12:8;]] = cl., κατὰ σ., Hdt., al.), face to face, II Jn 12, 3Jn.14; διὰ τοῦ σ. (of the Holy Spirit), [[luke 1 70|Luk.1:70]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16]], al.; ἀπὸ (ἐκ) τοῦ σ. (cf. ἀπὸ σ. εἰπεῖν, Plat., al.), of speaking by word of mouth, [[luke 22 71|Luk.22:71]], [[acts 22 14|Act.22:14]]; δόλος (ψεῦδος) ἐν τ. σ., [[1-peter 2 22|1Pe.2:22]], [[revelation 14 5|Rev.14:5]]" (LXX) ; metaphorically, ἡ ῥομφαία τοῦ σ., [[revelation 2 16|Rev.2:16.]] By meton., for speech (Soph.): [[matthew 18 16|Mat.18:16]] (LXX), [[luke 19 22|Luk.19:22 21:15]], [[2-corinthians 13 1|2Co.13:1]] (AS)

στόμαχος, -ου, ὁ (στόμα), prop., a mouth, an opening; (a) in early Gk. writers, the throat; (b) of the opening of the stomach (Arist.); (with) in later writers (Plut., al.), the stomach: [[1-timothy 5 23|1Ti.5:23.]]† (AS)

στρατεία (on the orthogr., see Deiss., BS, 181 f.), -ας, ἡ (οτρατεύω), [in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;] an expedition, a campaign, warfare: metaphorically, [[2-corinthians 10 4|2Co.10:4]] (-τιά, T), [[1-timothy 1 18|1Ti.1:18.]]† (AS)

στράτευμα, -τος, τό (στρατεύω), [in LXX: 1Ma.9:34, 2Ma.5:24 2Mac 8:21 2Mac 12:38 2Mac 13:13; pl., Jdth.11:8, 4Ma.5:1 * ;] 1. = στρατεία (Hdt., al.). 2. an army, a host: pl., [[matthew 22 7|Mat.22:7]], [[revelation 9 16|Rev.9:16 19:14, 19]]; = soldiers, company of soldiers, [[acts 23 10|Act.23:10, 27]]; pl., [[luke 23 11|Luk.23:11.]]† (AS)

στρατεύω and depon., -ομαι, so always in NT (στρατός, an encamped army), [in LXX for מההּ hith., יָצָא, צָבָא; metaphorically, 4Ma.9:23 ;] used of the general, to make war, do battle, and (chiefly) of the soldiers serving under him, to serve as a soldier: [[luke 3 14|Luk.3:14]], [[1-corinthians 9 7|1Co.9:7]], [[2-timothy 2 4|2Ti.2:4]]. Metaphorical (cf. MM, ii, xxiii), of spiritual conflict, to war, make war: [[2-corinthians 10 3|2Co.10:3]], [[1-timothy 1 18|1Ti.1:18]], [[james 4 1|Jas.4:1]], [[1-peter 2 11|1Pe.2:11]].† (AS)

στρατηγός, -οῦ, ὁ (στραός, ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for סָגָן (always in pl.), שַׂר ;] 1. a military commander, a general (Hdt., al.). 2. A civic commander, a governor, magistrate (Hdt., Xen., al.): [[acts 16 20|Act.16:20, 22 16:35-36, 38]]. 3. The commander of the Levitical guard of the Temple, ὁ σ. τ. ἱεροῦ (EV, captain of the Temple): [[acts 4 1|Act.4:1 5:24, 26]]; pl., [[luke 22 4|Luk.22:4, 52]].† SYN.: ἄρχων (cf. EGT on [[acts 16 20|Act.16:20;]] Ramsay, St. Paul, 217). (AS)

στρατιά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;] 1. = στρατός, an army, a host: of angels (3Ki.22:19, al.), [[luke 2 13|Luk.2:13]]; of the stars of heaven ([[jeremiah 8 2|Jer.8:2]], [[2-chronicles 33 3|2Ch.33:3]]), [[acts 7 42|Act.7:42]]. 2. As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: [[2-corinthians 10 4|2Co.10:4]], T (WH, RV, στρατεία).† (AS)

στρατιώτης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX; [[2-samuel 23 8|2Ki.23:8]] B1, 2Ma.5:12 2Mac 14:39, III Mac 3:12; 3Ma.3:4 Mac3 * ;] a soldier: [[matthew 8 9|Mat.8:9]], [[mark 15 16|Mrk.15:16]], [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2]], [[acts 10 7|Act.10:7]], al.; metaphorically, σ. Χριστοῦ Ἰησ., [[2-timothy 2 3|2Ti.2:3.]]† (AS)
στρατολογέω, -ῶ (στρατός, λέγω), to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: [[2-timothy 2 4|2Ti.2:4]] (Diod., Plut., al.).† (AS)
στρατοπέδ-αρχος (Rec. -ης), -ου, ὁ (στρατόπεδον, ἄρχω), a military commander, esp. the Pretorian prefect: [[acts 28 16|Act.28:16]] (WH, om.).† στρατοπεδάρχης, see: στρατοπέδαρχος (AS)
στρατό-πεδον, -ου, τό (στρατός + πέδον, a plain), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 34 1|Jer.34:1]] (חַיִל), 2Ma.8:12, al. ;] (a) a military camp; (b) an army: [[luke 21 20|Luk.21:20.]]† (AS)

στρεβλόω, -ῶ (στρέφω), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 22 27|2Ki.22:27]] (פָּתַל hithp.), 3Ma.4:14, 4Ma.9:17 4Mac 12:4 4Mac 12:11 4Mac 15:14 * ;] to twist, torture. Metaphorical (cf. 2Ki, l.with), to twist or pervert language: [[2-peter 3 16|2Pe.3:16.]]† (AS)

στρέφω [in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ, also for סָבַב, etc. ;] to turn: with accusative of thing(s) dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 39|Mat.5:39;]] = ἀποσ-, to bring back, [[matthew 27 3|Mat.27:3]] (cf. [[isaiah 38 8|Isa.38:8]]); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, [[acts 7 42|Act.7:42;]] with accusative before εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, [[revelation 11 6|Rev.11:6.]] Pass., reflexive, to turn oneself: before εἰς, [[john 20 14|Jhn.20:14]], [[acts 7 39|Act.7:39 13:46]]; ptcp., στραφείς, with indic., [[matthew 7 6|Mat.7:6 9:22 16:23]], [[luke 7 9|Luk.7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61]], [[john 1 38|Jhn.1:38 20:16]]; id. before πρός, [[luke 7 44|Luk.7:44 10:22]] (WH, R, om.), [[luke 7 23|Luk.7:23 23:28]]; metaphorically, to change: absol., [[matthew 18 3|Mat.18:3]], [[john 12 40|Jhn.12:40]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).† (AS)

στρηνιάω, ῶ (στρῆνος, which see), [in Sm.: [[isaiah 61 6|Isa.61:6]] (אָכַל) * ;] a word which first appears in the middle comedy (Rutherford, NPhr., 475 f.), to run riot, wax wanton: [[revelation 18 7|Rev.18:7-9]] (cf. κατα-στρηνιάω).† SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), τρυφάω (AS)

στρῆνος, -ους, τό (cf. Lat. strenuus), [in LXX: [[2-kings 19 28|4Ki.19:28]] (שַׁאֲנָן)* ;] insolent luxury, wantonness: [[revelation 18 3|Rev.18:3]] (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, Sources, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).† (AS)
στρουθίον, -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for צִפּוֹר ;] dimin. of στρουθός a sparrow: [[matthew 10 29|Mat.10:29, 31]], [[luke 12 6|Luk.12:6-7]].† (AS)

στρωννύω or στρώννυμι (seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word), [in LXX for יַצַע hoph., etc. ;] to spread: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), [[matthew 21 8|Mat.21:8]], [[mark 11 8|Mrk.11:8]]; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, [[acts 9 34|Act.9:34;]] of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. [[ezekiel 23 41|Eze.23:41]]), [[mark 14 15|Mrk.14:15]], [[luke 22 12|Luk.22:12]].† (AS)
στυγητός, -όν (στυγέω, to hate), hated, hateful: [[titus 3 3|Tit.3:3.]]† (AS)

στυγνάζω (στυγνός, sombre, gloomy, sullen, [[isaiah 5 17|Isa.5:17]], Wis.17:5, Dan LXX 2:12*), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 27 35|Eze.27:35 28:19 32:10]] (שָׁמֵם)* ;] to have a sombre, gloomy appearance: of the human countenance (RV, his countenance fell), [[mark 10 22|Mrk.10:22;]] of the sky (so στυγνότης, Polyb., iv, 21, 1), [[matthew 16 3|Mat.16:3]] ([WH], R, mg., om.).† (AS)

στύλος (T, στῦλος, as in cl.), -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for עַמּוּד, also for קֶרֶשׁ, etc. ;] a pillar, regarded especially as a support: σ. πυρός, [[revelation 10 1|Rev.10:1;]] σ. ἐν τ. ναῷ, figuratively, [[revelation 3 12|Rev.3:12]], Metaphorical, [[galatians 2 9|Gal.2:9;]] τ. ἀληθείας, [[1-timothy 3 15|1Ti.3:15.]]† (AS)
Στωικός (Rec. -ϊκός, T, Στοϊκός), -ή, -όν, Stoic: [[acts 17 18|Act.17:18.]]† (AS)

σύ, pron. of 2nd of person(s), thou, you, genitive, σοῦ, dative, σοί, accusative, σέ, pl., ὑμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς (enclitic in oblique cases sing., except after prep. (BL, §48, 3), though πρὸς σέ occurs in [[matthew 25 39|Mat.25:39]]). Nom. for emphasis or contrast: [[john 1 30|Jhn.1:30, 4:10, 5:33, 39, 44]], [[acts 4 7|Act.4:7]], [[ephesians 5 32|Eph.5:32]]; so also perhaps σὺ εἶπας, [[matthew 26 64|Mat.26:64]], al. (M, Pr., 86); before voc., [[matthew 2 6|Mat.2:6]], [[luke 1 76|Luk.1:76]], [[john 17 5|Jhn.17:5]], al.; sometimes without emphasis (M, Pr., 85f.), as also in cl., but esp. as rendering of Heb. phrase, e.g. υἱός μου εἶ σύ (בְּנִי־אַתָּה, [[psalms 2 7|Psa.2:7]]), [[acts 13 33|Act.13:33]]. The genitive (σοῦ, ὑμῶν) is sometimes placed bef. the noun: [[luke 7 48|Luk.7:48, 12:30]], al.; so also the enclitic σοῦ, [[matthew 9 6|Mat.9:6;]] on τί ἐμοὶ κ. σοί, see: ἐγώ. (AS)
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ (συγγενής), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;] 1. kinship. 2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: [[luke 1 61|Luk.1:61]], [[acts 7 3|Act.7:3, 14]] † (AS)

σνγγενής, -ές (dative pl., -εῦσιν, [[mark 6 4|Mrk.6:4]], [[luke 2 44|Luk.2:44]], as though from -εύς, see Swete, Mk., l.with; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. 1Ma.10:89 A א2 *;) (σύν, γένος), [in LXX for דּוֹד, דּוֹדָה, מִשְׁפָּחָה ;] 1. congenital, natural, innate. 2. akin to; as subst., a kinsman: [[mark 6 4|Mrk.6:4]], [[luke 1 58|Luk.1:58 2:44 14:12 21:16]], [[john 18 26|Jhn.18:26]], [[acts 10 24|Act.10:24]]; of tribal kinship, [[romans 9 3|Rom.9:3 16:7, 11 16:21]].† SYN.: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (which see) (AS)

συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ (συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon), [in LXX: Sir prol.14 (B1N1 cm.) 313, 2Mac 14:20* ;] 1. confession. 2. fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance: [[1-corinthians 7 6|1Co.7:6]] (see ICC, in l). 3. pardon.† (AS)
συν-κάθημαι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[psalms 101 6|Psa.101:6]] (יָשַׁב) * ;] to sit together or with: with dative, [[acts 26 30|Act.26:30;]] before μετά, with genitive, [[mark 14 54|Mrk.14:54.]]† (AS)
περι-καθ-ίζω [in LXX for חָנָה, לָחַם ni., etc. ;] 1. to invest, besiege (Diod., 4Ki.6:24, 1Ma.11:61, al.). 2. to sit around: [[luke 22 55|Luk.22:55]], L, txt. † (AS)
συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: [[2-timothy 2 3|2Ti.2:3;]] with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, [[2-timothy 2 18|2Ti.2:18.]]† (AS)
συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass. to endure adversity with: with dative of person(s), [[hebrews 11 25|Heb.11:25.]] Not elsewhere.† (AS)

συν-καλέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for קָרָא ;] to call together: with accusative, [[mark 15 16|Mrk.15:16]], [[luke 15 6|Luk.15:6]], 9 (seel. -εῖται, see B1., § 55, 1), [[acts 5 21|Act.5:21.]] Mid., to call together to oneself: [[luke 9 1|Luk.9:1]] (and seel. in [[luke 15 6|Luk.15:6]], 9 see supr.) [[luke 23 13|Luk.23:13]], [[acts 10 24|Act.10:24 28:17]].† (AS)
συν-καλύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;] to veil or cover completely: with accusative, pass., [[luke 12 2|Luk.12:2.]]† (AS)
συν-κάμπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[psalms 68 10|Psa.68:10, 23]] (מעד hi.), etc. ;] to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, figuratively, [[romans 11 10|Rom.11:10]] (LXX).† (AS)

συν-κατα-βαίνω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[psalms 49 17|Psa.49:17]] (יָרַד), Wis.10:13, [[daniel 3 49|Dan LXX TH 3:49]] * ;] to go down with: [[acts 25 5|Act.25:5.]] In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.† (AS)
συν-κατά-θεσις (Rec συγκ-), -εως, ἡ (συνκατατίθημι) concord, agreement: [[2-corinthians 6 16|2Co.6:16]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

συν-κατα-τίθημι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[exodus 23 1|Exo.23:1]] (שִׁית יָד), [[exodus 23 32|Exo.23:32]] (בְּרִית), Da TH Su 1:20 * ;] to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: with dative, [[luke 23 51|Luk.23:51.]]† (AS)
συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-), 1. to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21). 2. to vote one a place among: pass., [[acts 1 26|Act.1:26.]] Not elsewhere .† (AS)

συν-κεράννυμι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), 2Ma.15:39 * ;] to mix or blend together, compound: with accusative, [[1-corinthians 12 24|1Co.12:24;]] ptcp. pf. pass., [[hebrews 4 2|Heb.4:2]], T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).† (AS)
συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to move together. Metaphorical, to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, [[acts 6 12|Act.6:12]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).† (AS)

συν-κλείω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;] to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, [[luke 5 6|Luk.5:6;]] metaphorically ([[psalms 31 9|Psa.31:9]], al.), [[romans 11 32|Rom.11:32]], [[galatians 3 22|Gal.3:22-23]].† (AS)

συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: [[romans 8 17|Rom.8:17]], [[ephesians 3 6|Eph.3:6]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[hebrews 11 9|Heb.11:9]], [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7]] (for exx., see Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).† (AS)

συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), [[ephesians 5 11|Eph.5:11]], [[revelation 18 4|Rev.18:4]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[philippians 4 14|Php.4:14.]]† (AS)

συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν, partaking jointly of: with genitive of thing(s), [[romans 11 17|Rom.11:17]], [[1-corinthians 9 23|1Co.9:23]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[philippians 1 7|Php.1:7;]] before ἐν, [[revelation 1 9|Rev.1:9.]]† (AS)

συν-κομίζω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[job 5 26|Job.5:26]] (עָלָה) * ;] 1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.). 2. to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): [[acts 8 2|Act.8:2]] (see Field, Notes, 116).† (AS)

συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַר ;] 1. to compound, combine: [[1-corinthians 2 13|1Co.2:13]], R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.). 2. In Arist. and later writers (Wis.7:29, a1.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), [[2-corinthians 10 12|2Co.10:12]] 3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret ([[genesis 40 8|Gen.40:8]], 1Co, l.with, R, mg. 2 (but see reff. supr.).† (AS)
συν-κύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[job 9 27|Job.9:27]] (עָזַב), Sir.12:11 19:26 * ;] 1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.). 2. to be bowed down: [[luke 13 11|Luk.13:11.]]† (AS)

συγκυρία, -ας, ἡ (συγκυρέω, to happen), [in Sm.: [[1-samuel 6 9|1Ki.6:9]] (מִקְרֶה) * ;] (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα), chance, coincidence: κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), [[luke 10 31|Luk.10:31]] (Hippocr., Eccl.).† (AS)

συν-χαίρω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: [[genesis 21 6|Gen.21:6]] (צָחַק), 3Ma.1:8 R * ;] 1. to rejoice with: with dative of person(s), [[luke 1 58|Luk.1:58 15:6, 9]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17-18]], EV; with dative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 12 26|1Co.12:26 13:6]]. 2. to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

συν-χέω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בָּלַל, רָגַז, etc. ;] to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaphorically, confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: [[acts 21 27|Act.21:27]] (cf. συν-χύννω).† (AS)
συν-χράομαι (Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: [[1-samuel 30 19|1Ki.30:19]] * ;] to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), to associate with: [[john 4 9|Jhn.4:9]] (Polyb., a1.).† (AS)

σύγχυσις, -εως, ἡ (συγχέω), [in LXX: [[genesis 11 9|Gen.11:9]] (בָּבֶל), [[1-kings 5 6|1Ki.5:6 5:12]](11) [[1-samuel 14 20|1Ki.14:20]] (מְהוּמָה) * ;] confusion: of a popular uproar, [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29.]]† (AS)
